description: This file defines the GrainExtensionNotInstalledException class, a custom exception used within the Orleans.Runtime namespace to indicate that a grain extension method was invoked on a grain where that extension was not installed. It includes multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios and is marked as serializable.

classes.name: GrainExtensionNotInstalledException
classes.description: A sealed class representing an exception thrown when a grain extension method is invoked on a grain where that extension is not installed. It inherits from OrleansException and provides multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios.

methods.name: GrainExtensionNotInstalledException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes a new instance of the exception with a default message.
